title: Google's AI Didn't Answer. It Built the App.
script: You didn't open an app. You asked for one. Google Tabletop lets a group ask an AI agent to build the planning tools they need. Trip itinerary? Dinner poll? Expense splitter? Tournament bracket? Everyone can use it at the same time, like a Google Doc. It's still a US-only waitlist test for adults eighteen and over. But look at what changed. AI isn't just answering. It's building planning tools on demand.
cta: Follow AI Tested for the next AI workflow shift.
concept: Product transformation: prompt becomes tool, rapid app cards, collaboration split, waitlist reality check, software-on-demand close.
